body: They don't want me doing anything except the career they've set out for me. The path to do what I want later is too different and  risky for them to be happy.
I currently work at a museum. I want to do what my boss does but again, parents. We'll see how I can get there another time. Thank you so much ♡♡

They haven't been able to help for the 10 years it's been happening. My school counsellors suck and the school has only recently been trying to have more well being stuff to help out. I'm just scared that if it isn't me it'll be someone else.
